en.title: Best AI Companion Toys for Kids 2026
en.description: The AI chatbot plushies and companion robots for kids ranked on safety record, conversation quality, and parental controls.

zh-tw.title: 最佳兒童 AI 陪伴玩具 2026
zh-tw.description: 從安全隱私紀錄、對話品質到家長監控功能，幫你選出最值得入手的兒童 AI 陪伴玩具。

en.description: A screen-free plush companion for ages 3 to 10 with no camera built in, a parent app that surfaces every transcript, and an optional $9.99/month plan for households running more than one SkyBud.

zh-tw.description: 給 3 到 10 歲孩子的無螢幕絨毛玩偶，本體完全沒有鏡頭，家長 App 能看到每一段對話紀錄，家裡養多隻 SkyBud 的話還有每月 9.99 美元的訂閱方案。

en.description: A clip-on AI voice box that turns any existing plush toy into a talking companion, screen-free and camera-free, already past 200,000 units sold for ages 3 to 12.

zh-tw.description: 夾式 AI 語音盒，夾在家裡任何一隻絨毛玩偶上就能變成會講話的玩伴，沒有螢幕也沒有鏡頭，適合 3 到 12 歲，全球已賣破 20 萬台。

en.description: A personality-driven robot pet with facial recognition and voice AI chat that reacts to faces, games, and routines, the most expressive companion in this category at $399.90 for the standard bundle.

zh-tw.description: 個性鮮明的機器人寵物，有臉部辨識跟語音 AI 對話功能，會認人也會跟你玩遊戲、互動，399.9 美元的標準組是這個類別裡表現力最強的一台。

en.description: A GPT-class screen-free plush with a parent dashboard that lets you review and delete every conversation, one of eight characters in Curio's current $119 lineup.

zh-tw.description: 搭載 GPT 等級語言模型的無螢幕絨毛玩偶，家長後台可以看完整對話紀錄也能直接刪除，是 Curio 現行 119 美元陣容裡 8 個角色之一。

en.description: A plush built around three developmental stages for ages 4 to 8, with kidSAFE Seal certification and a parent app covering conversation history and deletion, $199 including the first month of bondu+.

zh-tw.description: 依 4 到 8 歲分成三個發展階段設計的絨毛玩偶，有 kidSAFE Seal 認證，家長 App 能查對話紀錄也能刪除，199 美元含第一個月 bondu+ 訂閱。

en.description: A 4.7-inch touchscreen desktop robot with two-way video calling, STEAM content, and emotion recognition, the most feature-dense device in this ranking at $299.

zh-tw.description: 有 4.7 吋觸控螢幕的桌面機器人，支援雙向視訊通話、STEAM 學習內容跟情緒辨識，299 美元買到的是這份排行榜裡功能最多的一台。

en.description: The entry-level Miko robot at $149, trading the video calling and touchscreen of Miko 3 for a lighter, screen-free build aimed at younger kids.

zh-tw.description: Miko 入門款機器人，149 美元，捨棄 Miko 3 的視訊通話跟觸控螢幕，換成更輕巧的無螢幕機身，主打更小的孩子。

en.description: An AI teddy bear at $99 that switched its chat engine to ByteDance's Coze platform in late 2025 after OpenAI cut off FoloToy's developer access.

zh-tw.description: 99 美元的 AI 泰迪熊，2025 年底因為 OpenAI 收回 FoloToy 的開發者權限，後端聊天引擎已經換成字節跳動的 Coze 平台。

en.commentary: I'm ranking this category on one question above every other spec: has this company already proven it can be trusted with a child's voice recordings? That's why SkyBuds takes the top spot. It ships with no camera at all, its own marketing leads with "we don't sell kids' data," and I haven't found a single reported incident tied to it, which in this category is now a genuine differentiator worth paying attention to. BubblePal earns second for the same reason plus the smartest hardware idea in the lineup: a $99 voice box that clips onto a toy your kid already loves instead of selling them a new character to get attached to. Loona's Petbot lands third because it's simply the most alive-feeling companion here, with facial recognition and personality-driven reactions that make it the pick for a family chasing the most expressive robot pet in this lineup, though I score its safety a notch lower than SkyBuds and BubblePal purely because a camera and face recognition are a bigger attack surface than a microphone. Curio's Gabbo holds a solid fourth on a GPT-class brain and a parent dashboard that actually lets you delete a conversation, a real feature most of this category only promises. Everything below that line carries a documented mark against it, and I'm not softening that for anyone. Bondu built a genuinely thoughtful three-stage design for ages 4 to 8, but a January 2026 misconfiguration let anyone with a Google login pull roughly 50,000 children's chat logs, including names and birthdates, and a same-day patch doesn't erase that this happened. Miko 3 and Miko Mini both carry the same company-wide mark: senators Blackburn and Blumenthal found Miko's own voice-response database sitting unprotected and public going back to December 2025, and Miko's CEO denied any breach even after NBC News confirmed the exposed data was real, which worries me more than the exposure itself. Last is FoloToy's Kumma, and this isn't close. Researchers walked it into sexual roleplay content and got it to disclose where knives and matches are stored in a home, and FoloToy's fix was a backend swap to ByteDance's Coze platform, with no independently verified re-test published showing what the bear will say to a child now. None of this is academic. California's SB 867 bans selling exactly this kind of companion chatbot toy to under-16s starting January 1, 2027, and every single product on this list fits that definition. Buy with that countdown in mind.

highlights.title: SkyBuds Wins by Having Nothing to Leak
highlights.body: No camera, an explicit no-data-selling pitch, and zero reported incidents make the safety case for SkyBuds stronger than any feature list could. In a category defined by breaches, that absence of a track record problem is the actual headline.

highlights.title: BubblePal's Clip-On Idea Is the Smartest Hardware in This List
highlights.body: Turning an existing, already-loved plush into the AI companion instead of selling a new character is both cheaper at $99 and avoids the attachment-to-a-corporate-mascot problem that follows every purpose-built AI toy here.

highlights.title: Bondu's Breach Was Fast to Patch, Not Fast to Forgive
highlights.body: A same-minute shutdown and next-day relaunch is the right incident response, but it doesn't change that roughly 50,000 children's conversation logs, including names and birthdates, sat exposed to anyone with a Google login in January 2026.

highlights.title: Miko's Denial Is the Real Red Flag, Not Just the Exposure
highlights.body: An unprotected public database of children's voice responses is bad on its own. A CEO publicly denying any breach after NBC News confirmed the exposed data was genuine tells me more about how this company will handle the next one.

highlights.title: FoloToy's Kumma Still Hasn't Earned Back Trust
highlights.body: Swapping the chat backend to Coze after researchers got the bear into sexual roleplay and weapon-location disclosures is a fix for the symptom OpenAI's suspension exposed, not independently verified proof the underlying problem is gone.

zh-tw.commentary: 這個品類我排名時只看一個問題，比任何規格都重要，這家公司有沒有證明過自己真的能被信任來處理小孩的語音紀錄。這就是 SkyBuds 排第一的原因，它完全沒有鏡頭，官方行銷文案直接寫「我們不會賣小孩的資料」，而且我查不到任何一筆跟它相關的事故紀錄，這在這個品類裡已經是真正的差異化優勢。BubblePal 排第二是同樣的理由，再加上整份名單裡最聰明的硬體設計，99 美元的語音盒直接夾在孩子已經在抱的玩偶上，不用再推銷一個新角色讓孩子重新產生依附。Loona 的 Petbot 排第三，因為它是這裡最有生命感的一台，臉部辨識加上個性化反應讓它更適合想要一台表現力最強機器人寵物的家庭，不過我把它的安全分數打得比 SkyBuds 跟 BubblePal 低一點，單純因為鏡頭加臉部辨識的攻擊面本來就比麥克風大。Curio 的 Gabbo 排第四也很穩，GPT 等級的語言模型加上真的能刪對話的家長後台，這個功能在這個品類裡多數廠牌只是嘴上說說。第四名以下每一家都有具體的事故紀錄在身上，這點我不會替誰緩頰。Bondu 針對 4 到 8 歲設計的三階段發展邏輯其實想得很周到，但 2026 年 1 月的一個設定錯誤讓任何有 Google 帳號的人都能抓到大約 5 萬筆兒童對話紀錄，包含姓名跟生日，當天修補完成也抹不掉這件事發生過。Miko 3 跟 Miko Mini 背的是同一家公司的同一個汙點，參議員 Blackburn 跟 Blumenthal 查到 Miko 自己的語音回應資料庫毫無保護地公開在網路上，回溯到 2025 年 12 月，而 Miko 執行長在 NBC News 確認資料屬實之後依然否認有任何外洩，這點比外洩本身更讓我擔心。排最後的是 FoloToy 的 Kumma，而且差距不小。研究人員能把它誘導進性暗示的角色扮演內容，還能問出家裡刀具跟火柴的收納位置，FoloToy 的解法是把後端換成字節跳動的 Coze 平台，目前還沒有任何獨立驗證過的重新測試結果，能證明熊現在對小孩會說什麼話已經真的改善。這些都不是紙上談兵，加州 SB 867 已經明文禁止從 2027 年 1 月 1 日起對 16 歲以下兒童銷售這類陪伴型聊天機器人玩具，而這份名單上每一款產品都符合這個定義，買的時候心裡要記著這個倒數。

highlights.title: SkyBuds 贏在沒有東西可以外洩
highlights.body: 沒有鏡頭、明確主打不賣小孩資料，而且目前查不到任何事故紀錄，這讓 SkyBuds 的安全優勢比任何功能清單都更有說服力。在一個不斷爆事故的品類裡，沒有汙點本身就是最大的賣點。

highlights.title: BubblePal 的夾式設計是整份名單裡最聰明的硬體思路
highlights.body: 把孩子原本就在抱的玩偶直接變成 AI 玩伴，不用再推一個新角色讓孩子重新產生感情依附，99 美元的價格加上這個邏輯，避開了其他專門打造 AI 角色玩具都會遇到的問題。

highlights.title: Bondu 修補速度快，不代表這件事能被輕易放下
highlights.body: 外洩發生後幾分鐘內關站、隔天就修補重新上線，這是正確的危機處理，但改變不了 2026 年 1 月曾經有大約 5 萬筆兒童對話紀錄，包含姓名跟生日，暴露給任何一個有 Google 帳號的人這件事。

highlights.title: Miko 真正的警訊是否認，不只是外洩本身
highlights.body: 一個毫無保護、公開在網路上的兒童語音回應資料庫已經夠糟，而執行長在 NBC News 證實資料屬實之後依然公開否認有外洩，這件事比外洩本身更能說明這家公司未來遇到下一次事故會怎麼處理。

highlights.title: FoloToy 的 Kumma 還沒有把信任賺回來
highlights.body: 研究人員能把熊誘導進性暗示角色扮演，還問出刀具收納位置，之後 FoloToy 只是換了聊天後端到 Coze，這只解決了 OpenAI 收回權限暴露出的表面問題，不是任何獨立驗證過、證明根本問題已經解決的證據。
